ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The upper part of the figure is a rectangle, the top is labeled with width 12 cm, and the left side is labeled with rectangle height 10 cm. There is a pink dashed line at the bottom edge of the rectangle, and the dashed line connects to the two upper endpoints of the triangle below. The overall vertical height on the right from the top of the rectangle to the bottom vertex of the triangle is labeled 16 cm. Then reason: According to the specified method, divide the figure into the upper rectangle and the lower triangle. The area of the rectangle is 12 × 10 = 120 square centimeters. The base of the triangle is the dashed segment, which is the same as the width of the rectangle, 12 cm. The height of the triangle equals the total height minus the rectangle height, that is 16 - 10 = 6 cm. The area of the triangle is (1/2) × 12 × 6 = 36 square centimeters. The total area is 120 + 36 = 156 square centimeters.
